sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.skill IN ('LLM', 'GenAI') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT fp.posting_key) AS share_llm_genai_skills FROM fct_posting AS fp JOIN posting_skills AS ps ON fp.posting_key = ps.posting_key WHERE fp.is_open = TRUE AND fp.remote_us = TRUE AND fp.family_label = 'ML Engineer'
